title: Grammar: How to say and read a price
subtitle: Unit 5: Numbers, money and prices

steps.title: How to say and read a price
steps.body:
• Dollar sign after the number, comma for cents, space for thousands: 12,50 $ and 1 200 $.
• vingt and cent take s when they are multiplied and nothing follows: quatre-vingts dollars (80), deux cents dollars (200). With another number after: quatre-vingt-deux, deux cent trois.
• dollar takes s after 2 and more: trois dollars; cent (coin) also: dix cents.
